sections.title: Egyszerű felület
sections.note: The recommended option is built if you do not answer. S01, S03 and S06 shape the first WPs; the rest can wait until the S6 look checkpoint.

questions.why: You wrote 'corner left'. Bottom-left puts the Back slot directly above the dial, so it is always in the same spot, the shortest move from the dial. Top-left reads like a classic menu dropping down.

opts.d: The column rises above the dial. Back is the bottom item, touching the dial.
The column hangs below the dial. Back is the bottom item, so it is the farthest from the dial.
Mirror of A, for right-handed touch use. The hint pill moves left.

questions.why: 88 px reads as a deliberate object without eating the drawing; on a phone a quarter of 88 px is still a 60+ px target.

opts.d: As designed (01_DESIGN §2).
Smaller, quieter; the core glyph shrinks to 16 px.
Bigger, more 'console'; better for touch.

questions.why: Four slots plus Bezár. Option A keeps everyday tools (undo, select, note) one level away; B gives View and Project their own roots but pushes those tools into search.

opts.d: Rendszer holds Nézet, Projekt, Kimenet, Beállítások (02_MENU-TREE §2).
Undo / Mozgatás / Jegyzet only by keys and search.
Alapozás · Nyílászárók+Szabályok · Villamosság · Rendszer — mirrors the workflow bar.

questions.q: The hint pill next to the dial while a tool runs?
questions.why: With every panel gone, the one-line tool hint is the only instruction left. Always-on is clutter; never is guesswork.

opts.t: Shows on start and on every message, fades after 6 s
opts.d: Hovering the dial brings it back.

opts.t: Always visible while a tool runs
opts.d: One line, ellipsis.
The dial icon only; hints via search help.

questions.why: A stable root builds muscle memory. The canvas right-click menus already carry every selection action.

opts.t: Right-click menus only; root stays fixed
opts.d: Double-click a room still opens the type wheel.

opts.t: Root slot 1 becomes 'Kijelölt: <name>' while something is selected
opts.d: The other root items shift down by one.

questions.why: Needs a free combination that a browser does not take. Ctrl+Shift+E is free in Chrome on Windows (to be confirmed in S0).

opts.d: E = Egyszerű. Also the ◔ header button and the menu item Rendszer › Beállítások › Normál felület.
One key, but F2 is 'rename' muscle memory for many.
Button and menu only.

questions.q: When does the menu close after a pick?
questions.why: Toggles you try one after another (2D/3D, styles, layers) are tedious if the menu closes each time; tools want the canvas immediately.

opts.t: Tools and actions close it; toggles stay open
opts.d: Marked ↺ in the item.
Simplest rule.

questions.why: The Zion screens read as a clean condensed technical face. Bahnschrift ships with Windows 10/11 (offline, no download); Segoe UI is what the rest of the Planner uses.

opts.d: Falls back to Segoe UI elsewhere.
Same family as Normal mode.

questions.q: Entering simple mode changes the view?
questions.why: A clean screen invites a clean view, but changing the camera behind the user's back breaks 'the drawing never changes'.

opts.t: No — the view stays as it was
opts.d: 2D/3D is one menu pick away.

opts.t: Switch to the 2D plan on entry
opts.d: And restore the camera on exit.

questions.q: Dialogs (tables like Áramkör-lista, Ellenőrzés) in simple mode?
questions.why: They are big and shared with Normal mode; restyling them is a separate job.

opts.t: Keep the normal dialog look for now
opts.d: A later round may give them the glass style.

opts.t: Glass style in simple mode (S6 extra)
opts.d: Adds CSS for #modal under body.ui-simple; more screenshots at the ⏸.
